OpenXPlay Relay’s CarPlay receiver is based on DiPlay and xcertplay, both licensed under GPL-3.0. Thanks to their authors and contributors.

Includes AndroidX, Bouncy Castle, JmDNS and SLF4J. Source and license notices accompany this release.
